name: Hindware Home Innovation Ltd
title: Hindware Home Innovation Ltd - 542905 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Bathware steady at 10.3% FY26 EBITDA margin with 15-20% FY27 growth guided, but pipes ran into resin spike and March supply shortfall, and Roorkee capacity is adding to a sub-par utilisation base.

utilisation.quote: Capacity utilization for FY26 for our sanitaryware plants stood at approximately 82%, while the faucet plant operated at 89%

capex.quote: net bank debt has increased from 385 to INR429 crore during the year, primarily on account of the capex expansion for the Roorkee plant

triggers.label: Faucet price hikes 15% + 3%
triggers.quote: mid-January, we took a 15% price increase in faucets

triggers.label: Pipes April growth ~50%
triggers.quote: we recorded growth of around 50% last month

triggers.label: Pipes March execution ~50% of prior year
triggers.quote: we were able to execute only around 50% of the business we had done in March last year

triggers.label: Roorkee capacity added, ramp H2 FY27
triggers.quote: with a more meaningful contribution anticipated in the second half of FY27 as utilization levels improve

triggers.label: Bathware FY27 growth 15-20%
triggers.quote: we remain confident of delivering growth in the range of 15% to 20% in FY27, along with an improvement in margins

guidance.quote: we remain confident of delivering growth in the range of 15% to 20% in FY27, along with an improvement in margins

guidance.value: 1% to 2% YoY in FY27 and another 1% to 2% in FY28
guidance.quote: We're confident of delivering about between 1% and 2% improvement in the EBITDA margin in this financial year
our plan is to expand our overall margins of the business, on a console basis ranging 1.5% to 2% systematically at least for the next 2 years
We are targeting the 8% to 10% EBITDA margin in the consumer appliances business within the next two financial years

guidance.value: INR100 crore per quarter by Q1-Q2 FY27
guidance.quote: we will hit the INR100 crore target within Q1 and Q2 of this year

guidance.value: Positive EBITDA in Q1 FY27, full year positive
guidance.quote: we expect it in Q1 FY27 itself, and the full year will definitely be positive

guidance.value: Substantial reduction of 30% to 40% in next two years
guidance.quote: a substantial reduction by almost 30% to 40% should happen in next two years
we should get back to regular supplies from all our suppliers by June
we are expecting an increase of around 14% to 15% in volume
